content.description:
Drivetrain is on a mission to empower businesses to make better decisions. Our financial planning & decision-making platform helps companies scale and achieve their targets predictably.

Drivetrain is a remote-first company headquartered in the San Francisco Bay Area. Founded in 2021 by a couple of ex-Googlers, Drivetrain is a fast-growing company on a trajectory for success with backing from leading venture capital firms.

Drivetrain provides a great culture for its employees to thrive in and be happy.

💜 Remote-friendly: Drivetrain brings together the best and the brightest, no matter where they are and provides them a great degree of autonomy. We trust our people.
🗣️ Open & transparent: We know that when our creators have access to all the information they need, their best work will emerge.
👏 Idea-friendly: We provide an environment to explore new ideas, to take risks, to make mistakes, and to learn, so you can succeed. Anyone in the company can come up with great ideas and become a catalyst for positive change. We let the best ideas win.
👥 Customer-centric: We follow a product-led growth strategy, continuously learning from our customers and collaborating to build the amazing software that Drivetrain is.

Why This Role Matters

We're growing fast, and SEO is one of our most important growth levers — now we’re ready to scale it even further.

That’s where you come in.

As our SEO Content Specialist, you’ll work at the heart of our content engine: shaping briefs, editing content, applying SEO best practices, and publishing to thousands of readers.
You’ll work with our Content Lead and learn what it takes to run a high-performing B2B content operation.
This is a hands-on role — perfect for someone who’s detail-oriented, process-savvy, and wants to grow into SEO or content marketing leadership.

What You’ll Own

Turn ideas into structured, reader-focused briefs.
Edit articles to ensure clarity, flow, tone, and usefulness to our audience.
Optimize content for SEO, AEO, and human readability.
Track content progress, project manage our team of writers, and keep the publishing pipeline running smoothly.Help scale our publishing while maintaining a very high bar on content quality.

What Makes You a Great Fit

1–3 years of experience in content writing, editing, or SEO — you genuinely love content.
Excellent written English and a sharp eye for clarity, structure, and tone.
Super organized and proactive — you don’t wait to be told what’s blocked.
Eager to learn and looking to build a long-term career in marketing.

Bonus Points For

Experience managing freelancers or editorial workflows.
B2B or SaaS content exposure.Familiarity with on-page SEO best practices.
Comfortable with CMS tools (Webflow, WordPress, etc.).

Why Join Us?

You’ll learn from experienced content, SEO, and marketing leaders, fast.
You’ll have real ownership, not just checklist work.You’ll help shape the systems that scale our brand.
You’ll see direct impact: from brief → publish → traffic → revenue.
Sounds exciting? Apply at careers@drivetrain.ai. It may just be the next best decision you’ve ever made!
